feed.title: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery
feed.subtitle: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery on GitHub

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick has Heap Use-After-Free in ImageMagick MSL decoder
entry.content:
A heap use-after-free vulnerability in ImageMagick's MSL decoder allows an attacker to trigger access to freed memory by crafting an MSL file.

=================================================================
==1500633==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free on address 0x527000011550 at pc 0x5612583fa212 bp 0x7ffedb86d160 sp 0x7ffedb86d150
READ of size 8 at 0x527000011550 thread T0

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-fpvf-frm6-625q
  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-28687
  • https://github.com/dlemstra/Magick.NET/releases/tag/14.10.4
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-fpvf-frm6-625q

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick: Write heap-buffer-overflow in PCL encoder via undersized output buffer
entry.content:
A heap-buffer-overflow vulnerability exists in the PCL encode due to an undersized output buffer allocation.

WRITE of size 1 at 0x7e79f91f31a0 thread T0
